blocks.en: Formal reports have **three main sections**: the **introduction**, the **body** and the **close**.
blocks.ms: Laporan formal ada **tiga bahagian utama**: **pengenalan**, **isi** dan **penutup**.

en: Helps the reader understand the context; introduces the subject and why it is important; previews the main idea; establishes tone and the writer’s relationship to the audience
ms: Bantu pembaca fahami konteks; perkenal subjek dan kepentingannya; pratonton idea utama; tetapkan nada dan hubungan penulis dengan audiens

ms: Ringkas poin utama; tekankan manfaat; himpun semua item tindakan

blocks.en: Five characteristics of effective report content
Six strategies for a successful proposal

en: Prove that the proposal is workable
Follow instructions for a solicited proposal; present and summarise the problem; propose a solution; refer to the RFP or what led you to submit
ms: Ikut arahan untuk cadangan solicited; bentang dan ringkas masalah; cadangkan penyelesaian; rujuk RFP atau sebab anda menghantar

en: Gives details on the proposed solution; specifies anticipated results; promotes the offering persuasively; maintains an objective tone; avoids overselling
ms: Beri butiran penyelesaian; nyatakan hasil dijangka; promosi tawaran secara memujuk; nada objektif; elak terlalu menjual

en: Summarises key points; emphasises benefits; summarises merits of your approach; restates why you should do the job; asks for a decision; last chance to persuade
ms: Ringkas poin utama; tekankan manfaat; ringkas kelebihan pendekatan; ulang kenapa anda patut buat kerja; minta keputusan; peluang akhir memujuk

blocks.en: The slides show: revising, producing, distributing, and the LO says four tasks. The textbook’s four tasks are revise, produce, proofread, distribute; “proofread” is not on the slide text, so confirm.
blocks.ms: Slaid tunjuk: semakan semula, penghasilan, pengedaran, dan LO kata empat tugas. Empat tugas buku teks ialah revise, produce, proofread, distribute; “proofread” tiada dalam teks slaid, jadi sahkan.

en: Ensure content is clear, logical and reader-oriented
ms: Pastikan kandungan jelas, logik dan mengutamakan pembaca

q.en: Four ways to be sensitive to audience needs?
q.ms: Empat cara peka terhadap keperluan audiens?

a.en: “You” attitude, etiquette, emphasise the positive, bias-free language.
a.ms: Sikap “you”, etiket, tekankan positif, bahasa bebas bias.

a.en: Headings, transitions, preview sections, review sections.
a.ms: Tajuk, peralihan, bahagian pratonton, bahagian ulang kaji.

a.en: Known audience and message meets with approval.
Complex or longer reports and messages sent to outsiders.
a.ms: Laporan kompleks atau panjang dan mesej kepada pihak luar.

q.en: Three main sections of a formal report?
What does a report introduction do?

a.en: Gives context, introduces the subject and why it matters, previews the main idea, sets tone and relationship.
a.ms: Beri konteks, perkenal subjek dan kepentingan, pratonton idea utama, tetapkan nada.

q.en: What does the body of a report do?
What does the close of a report do?

a.en: Summarises key points, emphasises benefits, brings action items together.
a.ms: Ringkas poin, tekankan manfaat, himpun item tindakan.

q.en: Five characteristics of effective report content?

a.en: Accurate, complete, balanced, clear and logical, documented properly.
a.ms: Tepat, lengkap, seimbang, jelas dan logik, didokumenkan.

q.en: Six strategies for a proposal argument?

a.en: Demonstrate knowledge, concrete information, research competition, prove workable, “you” attitude, attractive package.
a.ms: Tunjuk pengetahuan, maklumat konkrit, kaji pesaing, buktikan boleh dilaksana, sikap “you”, bungkus menarik.

q.en: What goes into a proposal introduction?

a.en: Follow instructions, present the problem, propose a solution, refer to the RFP or what led to the proposal.
a.ms: Ikut arahan, bentang masalah, cadang penyelesaian, rujuk RFP.

q.en: What goes in the body of a proposal?

a.en: Details of the solution, anticipated results, persuasive promotion, objective tone, avoid overselling.
a.ms: Butiran penyelesaian, hasil dijangka, promosi memujuk, nada objektif, elak terlalu menjual.

q.en: What goes in the close of a proposal?

a.en: Summarise key points, emphasise benefits, summarise merits, restate why you, ask for a decision.
a.ms: Ringkas poin, tekankan manfaat, kelebihan, ulang kenapa anda, minta keputusan.

q.en: How do you revise reports and proposals?
q.ms: Bagaimana menyemak semula laporan dan cadangan?

a.en: Evaluate organisation, style and tone; ensure clear, logical, reader-oriented content; improve readability; review online content.
a.ms: Nilai organisasi, gaya, nada; kandungan jelas, logik; kebolehbacaan; semak kandungan dalam talian.

a.en: Cover, title page, letter of transmittal, table of contents, synopsis or executive summary.
a.ms: Kulit, muka judul, surat penghantaran, jadual kandungan, ringkasan eksekutif.

a.en: Appendixes, bibliography, indexes, résumés or CVs of key players.
a.ms: Lampiran, bibliografi, indeks, resume/CV pemain utama.

a.en: Physical (courier, in person), digital (PDF, specialised format), online (CMS, shared workspace).
a.ms: Fizikal (kurier, peribadi), digital (PDF, format khusus), dalam talian (CMS, ruang kerja).

a.en: Company background, project description, requirements, decision criteria, proposal requirements, submission and contact information.
a.ms: Latar belakang, huraian projek, keperluan, kriteria keputusan, keperluan cadangan, penghantaran dan hubungan.

a.en: Identify decision criteria, allow sufficient response time, establish online tracking.
a.ms: Kenal pasti kriteria keputusan, masa respons cukup, penjejakan dalam talian.

q.ms: Yang mana BUKAN ciri kandungan laporan berkesan?
